entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: A renewed 4562 AR campaign by New Phyrexia to subjugate and compleat Dominaria, led by Sheoldred; prelude to the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Praetor who led the invasion, allied with the Society of Mishra, Rona and Ertai.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Phyrexian-controlled homeworld that launched the invasion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane under invasion.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: Ambitious ally of Sheoldred who assaulted Urza's Tower, struck down by Elspeth.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Resurrected ally of Sheoldred who oversaw Aron's compleation.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Faction allied with Sheoldred.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: Alliance of Dominaria's leaders and planeswalkers resisting the invasion.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: Benalish nobleman abducted and compleated, slain by his daughter Danitha.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: Aron's daughter, who slew the compleated Aron and led House Capashen.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Ghitu leader whose workshop was the Mana Rig; she triggered its self-destruction.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Coalition killed by compleated Ajani.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem planeswalker carrying Venser's spark, disassembled and taken to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Coalition planeswalker revealed to be a Phyrexian sleeper agent.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: Scholar of New Argive revealed as a sleeper agent and killed by Karn and Jaya.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Planeswalker building the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Archmage severely wounded by Rona.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Rejoined the Phyrexians and extracted Rona.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who struck down Rona.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: The Coalition's main base in Shiv and Jhoira's workshop.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact destroyed by Phyrexia at the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Site of the Temporal Anchor's construction, assaulted by Rona.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Device being built from Urza's blueprints.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The greater war of which this invasion was the opening act.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Region where Aron was ambushed at the Oyster Bay summit.

events.summary: Sheoldred allies with the Society of Mishra, Rona and a resurrected Ertai, raising an army of compleated Argivians and sleeper agents.
events.quote: The invasion began when Sheoldred , the Whispering One, allied with the Society of Mishra

events.summary: Sleeper agents abduct Aron Capashen at the Oyster Bay peace summit; Ertai oversees his compleation.
events.quote: Aron's compleation was personally overseen by Ertai

events.summary: The compleated Aron fights at Aerona and is slain by his daughter Danitha, who takes over House Capashen.
events.quote: he was confronted and ultimately slain by his grieving daughter, Danitha Capashen

events.summary: The Phyrexian vanguard attacks the Mana Rig; the Battle of the Mana Rig ends in a pyrrhic Coalition victory.
events.quote: The Battle of the Mana Rig was the largest engagement of the war thus far, ending in a pyrrhic Coalition victory.

events.summary: Stenn is revealed as a sleeper agent and killed by Karn and Jaya.
events.quote: Stenn , revealed to be a sleeper agent, was killed by Karn and Jaya Ballard

events.summary: Ajani is unmasked as a sleeper agent and kills Jaya, securing Karn for the enemy.
events.quote: Jaya herself fell to the compleated Ajani.

events.summary: Karn is disassembled and taken to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: was incapacitated, disassembled, and taken to New Phyrexia

events.summary: Jhoira triggers the Rig's self-destruction; the Golgothian Sylex is destroyed.
events.quote: Jhoira triggered the Rig's self-destruction to prevent its capture

events.summary: A month later Sheoldred returns with New Phyrexia's full might; hundreds of battles erupt across Dominaria.
events.quote: A month later, Sheoldred returned with the full might of New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Rona assaults Urza's Tower, wounds Jodah, and is struck down by Elspeth; Tezzeret extracts her.
events.quote: Rona severely wounded Jodah with her glaive before being struck down by Elspeth Tirel

relations.quote: Led by Sheoldred and her sleeper agents
he was confronted and ultimately slain by his grieving daughter, Danitha Capashen
Jaya herself fell to the compleated Ajani.
Tezzeret rejoined the Phyrexian cause and aided Rona's assault on Urza's Tower
